summary: Keystone Point, Chelan County: a crow's nest built in 1934, abandoned in the 1930s, now recorded as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Recorded as 'Gone' on the Washington Lookouts index; no source describes what remains on the site.

events.note: Panorama photographs taken, dated October 2, 1935 on the index page.

evidence.supports: Built 1934 as a crow's nest; abandoned in the 1930s
About three miles southwest of Entiat, Chelan County
Site filed under the Wenatchee National Forest

notes_for_editor: Only two index-style pages were readable; the brief's source pages gave no description of the site today. A search snippet for a geocaching listing (geocaching.com GCNRT7) says the summit now holds a TV reflector and radio receiving station and gives elevation 3880 ft, but the cached page returned no text, so nothing from it is used. The fetched sources say 3850 ft. The source says only 'Abandoned 1930s', so no abandoned event with a single year is recorded. Not verified: current access (a nwwildflowers.com snippet says 'closed' as of 10/6/26, unread).
